dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard what the Knights of Favonius have been saying? They're claiming they've defeated Stormterror!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: You know, I have been thinking — the Knights of Favonius can't be as impotent as they look. I'll bet they've been keeping their true power hidden until now...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Hmph. Well, whatever secret weapons they might have stashed away, there's still no way they can compete with the might of the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: It's a pity our previous attempts to coerce the Acting Grand Master were unsuccessful...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Ah, it's not a big problem. Didn't you notice about Signora? She didn't seem concerned about this minor quibble in the slightest. In fact, she seemed quite pleased with herself about something.

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: About something she's done... Or maybe something she intends to do...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Either way — we've got Signora at the helm, and even Barbatos himself would be no match for her!

dialogues.speaker: Lyudmila
dialogues.text: Well let's just hope Signora never meets her match in battle...

dialogues.speaker: Mikhail
dialogues.text: Relax! This is Signora we're talking about. As long as she's around, everything will be fine.
